name: Canmax Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Canmax Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of new energy lithium battery materials, and anti-static ultra-clean technology and medical equipment in China and internationally. The company offers battery-grade lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate, and other products and services for use in new energy vehicles, low-altitude flight, energy storage, and other fields. It also provides ESD control and cleanroom contamination control used for manufacturing semiconductors, new displays, hard disk drives, and biomedicine; and disposable sterile medical devices.
